g.text: Rear test pads UP; LEDs/components DOWN
Logical pad list below, NOT physical pad spacing
Rear: TP1 / TP2 / TP3 / TP6 + off-grid TP9
Front: TP8 GND bar (via lower anvil)
TP4 / PB3 and TP5 / PB4 are spare
Insulated wire from probe J2; NOT an upper pogo
J1 TOP VIEW - extended front edge up
2.54 mm mating posts; pin 1 lower left
P4 / PB3 and P5 / PB4: spare, NO ISP cable
Right-hand links depict contacts; not more jumpers
J1.6 -> probe J2 -> insulated slack wire -> anvil J1 -> P8 / P8L+P8R -> front TP8.
Fence and lower guide are mechanical; do not populate their header.
REMOVE CR2032. Wire and check continuity with all power OFF.
White lead = user-reported 3V3 VCC. Uno supply pins are NOT automatically wired in this drawing.
STOP: a 3.3V target cannot take direct 5V Uno ISP signals. Disconnect USB and target power.
Use verified SPI level translation or a voltage-compatible ISP host before reconnecting (not shown).
Uno 3V3 power does NOT change its I/O levels. Do not join supply outputs.
Colours match the user's reported COM6 harness; continuity and programming are not yet verified.
Do NOT use Uno RESET or the USB-interface ICSP header.
Arduino Uno ArduinoISP -> programming clip -> Ring IR PCB
GREY MISO | WHITE 3V3 VCC | BLUE SCK | PURPLE MOSI | BROWN RESET | BLACK GND
J1 = board-top view. Right-hand links represent spring/flat contacts, NOT extra cables.
